rationale: In scenario probes run identically against all three pins, claude's implementation avoids cursor's two duplicate-send paths (a repeated queued-into Stop and an older failed Stop both yield eligible-idle there) and, unlike codex, lets a queued action's own distinct-turn Stop end it as idle instead of stalling until owner recovery, while carrying reread expectations across A→B→C chains with the smallest change; its remaining gap (a distinct-turn Stop after completion, shared with codex) is a one-line fix.
